{{Quote|I did not see Skywalker sending his Jedi Knights to save the Nightsisters when the Yuuzhan Vong captured Dathomir.|[[Lomi Plo]], to [[Anakin Solo]]|<ref name="SbS" />}}
During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] '''invaded''' the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].<ref name="GatORW" /> As the planet was inhabited by the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Witches of Dathomir]], Dathomir became an obvious target for the Yuuzhan Vong in their crusade against the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and other [[Force Adept]]s.<ref name="TEA" /> Six months after the beginning of the conflict, the planet was threatened by the the invaders, prompting the native [[Teneniel Djo]], the [[Queen Mother]] of the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]], to join the war.<ref name="AoC2" /> The Yuuzhan Vong attacked Dathomir only one year and half after the start of the conflict. As the planet lacked technology and planetary defenses, they easily deployed troops and invaded the planet. However, after long months of fighting, the invaders did not succeed in defeating the Witches.<ref name="GatORW" /> Stuck in vain ground assaults, the Yuuzhan Vong abandoned their objectives and eventually renounced to their invasion.<ref name="TEA" /> Nevertheless, the planet was ravaged by the war.<ref name="JvS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>
